method: SkyLLM accuracy estimator, fixed-K=3 transfer with nonbinding budgets
comparison: Full neighbor reward mean versus zeroing only full-tie neighbor contributions, with fixed neighbors and denominator
inference: Deterministic first exact maximum in the frozen MAB physical action order, for the nonbinding-budget q-max case
distance_ties: Stable original training index order; native Faiss tie identity unspecified
counterfactual_deployment_only: train600 success priority among exact maxima, uniform among prior ties

datasets.OOF: Existing E19 folds, five H480/E120 splits, k=48, 50/50 GSM8K and BBH inner question weights
datasets.E24: Train600/k=60 and existing E24 1196 input-only questions, frozen E24 strata and weights

gate: Stop on exact zero effect bound for the same-deployment intervention. Added decoders are sensitivity only, including when their bound is positive. Further scoring requires a reproducible effect of the supported original procedure and a material score-impact bound.
e25_check: Restore frozen E24 U/P for E25 linear and MLP. Apply TV after cancellation to the difference-in-differences coefficient.
